articles.headline: Jérémy Doku out of Belgium's World Cup game against Iran
articles.description: Belgium's Jérémy Doku will not play in his team's World Cup match against Iran on Sunday due to illness.

articles.headline: De la Fuente urges caution over Yamal comparisons to Messi
articles.description: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente didn't confirm whether Lamine Yamal will make his first World Cup start on Sunday, while urging caution when comparing the Barcelona star to legends like Lionel Messi and Diego Maradona.

articles.headline: Cape Verde urged to 'do the impossible' at World Cup pre-Uruguay clash
articles.description: Cape Verde coach Bubista has challenged the team to "do the impossible" and build on their shock draw against Spain by sealing a place in the World Cup round-of-32.

articles.headline: Socceroos erred in US defeat, but more important now is the bounce back and beyond
articles.description: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. A heroic performance against Türkiye followed by a heartbreaking defeat to the US. Now it's about how the Socceroos respond.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily: Germany win late; Dutch win big; Norway fans in NYC
articles.description: It's yet another weekend of 2026 FIFA World Cup action, with four games slated for Saturday and a Norway fan takeover in New York City.

articles.headline: USA at the 2026 World Cup: Schedule, results, how to watch, news, analysis, injuries, more
articles.description: ESPN rounds up everything you need to know ahead of the United States' World Cup campaign.
